method: Visual inspection of contact sheets near_duplicate_review_0.jpg through near_duplicate_review_3.jpg
candidate_order: ascending pHash distance, then descending TinyCLIP cosine
reviewer: Codex visual inspection, not an independent human adjudication
finding: The 48 reviewed pairs depict different scenes or objects. Similar low-frequency layouts, including catalog clothing against blank backgrounds, explain several pHash matches.
scope: Only 48 of the 200 nearest reported candidates were visually inspected. No pair in the exhaustive comparison had pHash distance <= 6. This does not exclude all unknown crops.
